node.description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

__Type:__ Tsundere
__Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 1

**Girlfriend No. 002**

Karane is known for being straightforward and honest about how she feels about a given situation except for two subjects: her feminine figure (or supposed lack of) and her deep love for [Aijou Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou). Her desperate attempts to hide how she feels about a given situation despite her honest nature often make people think she is going to strike them.

__Type:__ Dandere
__Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 3

**Girlfriend No. 003**

Shizuka is rather timid especially given her rather quiet or mute voice which makes her rather distant from other people. However, ever since she met [Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou) she has become braver, even willing to sacrifice her own safety to help [Hakari](https://anilist.co/character/173759/Hanazono-Hakari) out. She is also the most modest of Rentarou's girlfriends as she refused to peep on him when he was taking a bath and even tried to stop them from doing so.

__Type:__ Kuudere
__Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 6

**Girlfriend No. 004**

Nano is practical to a fault, obsessed with solving a problem in the most efficient way possible no matter what.

Nano is the smartest among the girls. In her school exam, she gets the perfect score (700/700), which is better than the scores of genius-level characters in other manga. Nano has memorized hundreds of digits of Pi, which she sometimes uses to calm herself down. Due to her extreme intelligence and efficiency, in most difficult situations Nano is the first to come up with solutions. However, her solutions are sometimes brutal due to her lack of social experience.

__Type:__ Deredere
__Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 1

**Girlfriend No. 001**

Hakari is described as a "clumsily calculative" lady. She is often planning and plotting to achieve her goals which may or may not go as planned due to her clumsiness. She is prim and proper on the outside while inside she is just as much of a degenerate, if not more so, than the other members of the Hanazono family. She also teases [Inda Karane](https://anilist.co/character/173760) a lot, often leaving her embarrassed or pissed.

__Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 1

Rentarou is an extremely kind and thoughtful person who loves all of his many girlfriends very dearly, often to a scarily self-sacrificing degree.  

Before he began his days as a high school student, Rentarou had been rejected a total of 100 times. Following a rejection from his friend on the day of his junior high graduation, he goes to a matchmaking shrine and prays to the shrine's god, wishing for a happy high school life by getting a girlfriend. In response, the Love God appears before Rentarou, telling him that he will meet his "soulmate" in high school, and that they will fall in love at first sight. He then reveals that Rentarou has 100 of such soulmates, and that should he ever meet one, he must make them his girlfriend and make them happy, or else they will die.

__Type:__ MILF
__Occupation:__ High School Chairwoman
__Debut:__ Chapter 17

**Girlfriend No. 006** 

[Hakari](https://anilist.co/character/173759/Hakari-Hanazono)'s mother.
Hahari appears as a very mature and sophisticated woman, until she sees something cute. She has an uncontrollable love for cute things, including children, as well as Rentarou and his family. When she sees something she finds cute, she may start drooling. Like her daughter, she is also a pervert towards Rentarou as she is shown to have perverted fantasies about him. 
She is incredibly wealthy, and willing to throw her money around to get what she (or Rentarou) wants. Although she fell in love with Rentarou, Hahari still deeply loves her deceased lover. She feels guilty about falling in love again until Rentarou comforts her and assures her that there is nothing wrong with loving more than one person.

~!When she was very young, Hahari fell in love with a sickly boy her age. He did not have long to live, and because of how much she loved him, she made arrangements with doctors to artificially inseminate herself with his genes in order to leave "proof of his existence". She gave birth to Hakari when she was 13 years old. The boy she loved passed away before they could even kiss.!~

__Type:__ Druggie
__Occupations:__ Third-Year High School Student, Chemistry Club President
__Debut:__ Chapter 10

**Girlfriend No. 005**

Kusuri is energetic and ingenuitive; she is capable of creating a drug for almost anything. She doesn't tend to be concerned about the dangers of the drugs she makes, and will often happily force them upon others or take them herself without hesitation.

__Type:__ Maid
__Occupation:__ Personal Maid
__Debut:__ Chapter 30

**Girlfriend No. 008**

The personal maid of [Hahari Hanazono](https://anilist.co/character/173812/Hahari-Hanazono). Mei is polite and proper, rarely showing strong emotions. She is loyal to Hahari above all else, and is unlikely to do anything unless given permission or ordered to by Hahari specifically. Mei's fanatical loyalty to the Rentarou Family and the Hanazono Family results in her gladly offering to "eliminate" people that threaten, insult, or even mildly inconvenience [Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou), Hahari, or the other girlfriends.

Mei is an all-around maid. It seems that she can do nearly everything, including driving, cooking, shooting, and even nursing. Mei is also shown to exceed her already exceptional abilities if ordered to do so by Hahari.

__Type:__ Hangry
__Occupation:__ Third-Year Middle School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 24

**Girlfriend No. 007**

Kurumi absolutely loves food and possesses an extremely high metabolism. As such, she's almost constantly hungry, and she grows extremely cranky if she isn't eating the certain food that she happens to be craving for at the moment. Kurumi has a strong word-association when it comes to food. Almost anything can remind her of food, at which point she has to eat that food or else she will become irritable.

__Type:__ Narcissist
__Occupation:__ Second-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 39  

**Girlfriend No. 010**

Mimimi is very haughty and narcissistic, constantly complimenting herself and talking about her beauty. Despite her appearance of a naturally-beautiful rich girl, Mimimi actually works incredibly hard to provide for herself and keep herself beautiful. She works for herself to earn money, is frugal where appropriate so she can afford expensive, gorgeous clothing, and puts significant effort into her appearance. Though she puts a lot of value on outward appearances, Mimimi also recognizes inner beauty when she sees it.

**Type:** Self-Conscious 
**Occupation:** First-Year High School Student
**Debut:** Chapter 45

**Girlfriend No. 011**

Meme is extremely shy, to the point of wearing masks to hide her face in order to avoid drawing attention to herself. She strives to keep her face hidden no matter what. Meme also enjoys knitting, and spends time knitting a lot of little stuffed animals. She uses these stuffed animals for "misdirection", in which she runs away quickly and leaves a stuffed animal as a distraction so no one sees where she went. Meme wears a modest turtleneck beneath her school blazer, and dark pantyhose. She also wears a minimizing bra to conceal the size of her chest.

__Type:__ Masochist
__Occupations:__ First-Year High School Student, Baseball Club Member
__Debut:__ Chapter 33

**Girlfriend No. 009**

Iku loves baseball, to the point of spending hours recruiting for her team when it's on the verge of being disbanded. She is determined to do her best no matter what; because of this she's described as the embodiment of "stoicism" by Rentarou. Iku is also wildly masochistic, going so far as to train for hours until her body is in agony so she can enjoy the pain.

__Type:__ Gyaru
__Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 87

**Girlfriend No. 018**

Ahko is a girl that has a love of anything and everything cute. She collects cute things, even if it's things others wouldn't think are cute, and loves to share them with others. Due to her low blood pressure she has a perpetual dopey smile on her face. She usually has a very bubbly personality but it does appear to have its limits. When spending time with [Karane](https://anilist.co/character/173760) and her former gyaru friends, her latter insulted Karane and the Gorilla Alliance. Ahko was perfectly fine with letting her ex-friends get beaten up for insulting Karane.

__Type:__ America
__Occupation:__ Japanese Language Teacher
__Debut:__ Chapter 57

**Girlfriend No. 013**

Nadeshiko has a very freedom loving and stereotypically American personality due to her fascination with the United States, this was due to her finding and watching a VHS tape of a group of American Children acting in contrary to her family's strict traditional Japanese customs. She does not seem to be able to speak English despite her love of America.

__Type:__ Old Loli
__Occupation:__ Pensioner
__Debut:__ Chapter 75

**Girlfriend No. 016**

[Kusuri](https://anilist.co/character/173763/Kusuri-Yakuzen)'s grandmother.
Yaku comes off as a calmer and more mature version of Kusuri. She tends to act rather grandmotherly towards the others and seems to enjoy the youthful antics of the younger members of the family. She also is rather coy and tends to tease Rentarou. Yaku is also easily confused by modern technology and refers to smartphones as planks. She also seems to be afraid of cars. Yaku seems to have been born in the early 20th century (though there are references that make her sound older). Yaku's interest in the making of drugs and medical treatments seem to go back to World War II where she appears to have treated Imperial Japanese soldiers. During this time she met her husband, though she coyly refuses to go into detail.

__Type:__ Overenthusiastic Masseuse
**Occupation:** Third-Year Middle School Student
**Debut:** Chapter 69

**Girlfriend No. 015**

Momi is somewhat stoic and blunt, blatantly admitting to her love of massaging (especially women) without concern for how perverse it may sound. She loves touching things, especially things that are soft, including women and character-based mousepads. Momi is able to give massages that are so good, the receiver will pass out and lose all memories of the massage itself. This leads to a rumor circulating the school of a girl who gives amazing massages and disappears. When confronted with this rumor, she says that it is "probably her".

__Type:__ Eco-Friendly Giantess
**Occupation:** First-Year High School Student
**Debut:** Chapter 64

**Girlfriend No. 014**

Yamame is a very kind and gentle girl who speaks like she is from the country. She is self-conscious about her height, but is proud that she can protect others with it. She is afraid of fire due to its destructive nature. When working in the fields, she often wears stilts to avoid crushing the crops. In addition to the stilts, she wears an apron, a backpack, and keeps her tie in her breast pocket.

__Type:__ Knight / Spoiled Baby
__Occupation:__ Third-Year High School Student, Kendo Club Captain
__Debut:__ Chapter 81

**Girlfriend No. 017**

On the surface Kishika is polite but highly discipline person speaking and carrying herself like a knight. She tends to strict on herself and others and seems to be an addition straightman in the Rentarou family. This all conceals the real Kishika that wants to be spoiled and even outright babied, especially by [Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou) and [Hahari](https://anilist.co/character/173812/Hanazono-Hahari). After she indulges in her desire to be babied she usually is embarrassed to the point of begging for death.

__Type:__ Cousin 
__Occupation:__ First-Year Middle School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 51

**Girlfriend No. 012**

Chiyo is reliable and tidy which led to her becoming class president. But, she secretly dislikes the high expectations others place on her. When she takes her glasses off, she becomes anxious and begins crying uncontrollably.

The god of a local shrine who informs Rentarou that due to his constant prayers to his shrine, and partially due to him being distracted when watching [Castle in the Sky](https://anilist.co/anime/513/Tenkuu-no-Shiro-Laputa/), he overly blessed Rentarou to meet 100 soulmates during his high school life.

The boy with a terminal illness whom Hahari had fallen in love with when she was a schoolgirl. Before he died, Hahari was artificially inseminated using his sperm at the age of 13, which led to the birth of Hakari. Rentarou meets his spirit after rescuing Hakari and causing Hahari to fall in love with him.
Hiro's personality can described as immature and sly while also being very protective of his daughter Chiyo. He thinks very highly of Rentarou.
Artist of The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You.
Catcher for Jurassic High School's baseball team
The girl who rejected main character Rentarou Aijou's 100th love confession.

Shizuka's mother
~!She wants Shizuka to speak properly, even going as far as to abuse her daughter and take away her phone, but after speaking with Rentarou, she accepts Shizuka's way of speaking.!~

She was shown to be a calm person with a cheerful and childish temperament similar to her daughter. Like the rest of the family she has taken the immortality drug, assuming the body of an 8-year-old child.

Due to taking an immortality drug he has the appearance of an 8-year-old child. He loves his daughter very much, telling Rentarou to leave all his girlfriends to show his love for Kusuri. 

He accepts Rentarou after he sees that Rentarou would give his life for her, however it continues to bother him that he has more girlfriends.
A former J-pop idol who attempts to train Rentarou's girlfriends as J-pop idols.
Pitcher of Jurassic High School's baseball team
